# External Skills

Vendored copies of third-party skill repos, cloned in with their `.git` stripped.

Each subfolder holds a `REFERENCE.md` recording its upstream source. The link/list scripts
scan `skills/internal/` only, so externals are excluded from local install and from
`plugin.json`/`README.md` registration.

| Skill | Source |
|-------|--------|
| caveman | https://github.com/juliusbrussee/caveman |
| mattpocock-skills | https://github.com/mattpocock/skills |
| ponytail | https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail |
| agent-skills | https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills |
| vercel-ai | https://github.com/vercel/ai |
| vercel-workflow | https://github.com/vercel/workflow |
| agent-browser | https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-browser |
| json-render | https://github.com/vercel-labs/json-render |
| agentic-commerce-skills | https://github.com/vercel-labs/agentic-commerce-skills |
